summary: Schedule metrics-utility with `crontab -e`; the example runs the gather script hourly (`0 */1 * * *`) and the report script at 4:00 AM on the 2nd of each month (`0 4 2 * *`).
questions: How do I schedule metrics-utility with cron?
How often should metrics-utility gather run?

answer_card.title: Schedule metrics-utility on RHEL
answer_card.answer_md:
Run `crontab -e` and add:
```
0 */1 * * * /home/my-user/cron-gather   # gather hourly
0 4 2 * * /home/my-user/cron-report      # report 04:00 on the 2nd
```
Verify with `crontab -l` and `/var/log/cron`.
